title: Fourier formula for coordinate averaging
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, let $J\subseteq[n]$, and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. The uniform expectation over $y\in\{0,1\}^n$ of $f$ evaluated at the point equal to $x$ on $J$ and to $y$ outside $J$ is $\displaystyle\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}\mathbf{1}_{\{S\subseteq J\}}\widehat f(S)\chi_S(x)$, where the indicator is $1$ when $S\subseteq J$ and $0$ otherwise.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $J\subseteq[n]$, and $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. If $x\star_Jy$ keeps $x$ on $J$ and $y$ elsewhere, then $\mathbb E_y f(x\star_Jy)=\sum_{S\subseteq J}\widehat f(S)\chi_S(x)$.
